aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food truck and catering operators: online orders, collection times, fewer repeated questions. Founder: Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software for food truck and mobile catering operators, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep the flow of orders smooth and spend less time on repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab came about to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software for them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our aim is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools built on how these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started from one simple observation: food truck operators need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After building Village Foodie, a directory that helps people find food trucks coming to their area, I studied more about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Compared with traditional restaurants, food trucks are always moving, working in different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can manage. The system works from each dish’s preparation time and how many are prepared at once.

comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place you are at on that day.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work at different locations?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is neither a minimum term nor a notice period. You can cancel whenever you like; the fee is billed monthly in advance, and you keep access until the end of the month you paid for.

comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers arrive at the food truck: they choose dishes and their collection time, pay online or on collection, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or POS terminal takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year — ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Give customers the option to order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: When you hand out a buzzer, give the order its number — that way you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen visible to customers that shows order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on HatchGrab’s public map, so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates, such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety, in one place. We remind you before anything expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one links straight to its own order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with special prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to use HatchGrab: a live-updating kitchen screen, and the only way to keep taking orders when the signal drops.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much food your kitchen can cook at a time and how long it takes. As soon as a time slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward your returning customers with digital stamp cards — collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into meal deals and offer extras at checkout to raise your average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies — for questions that come in on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Run several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — all showing the same orders live.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give your staff their own logins with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the signal drops, online ordering pauses and customers cannot place orders you would not see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you keep taking orders even offline; the web dashboard needs an internet connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: When customers order online, take card payment upfront via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a deadline for items that need advance notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that do not show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter what each dish costs and see your real profit at every event, not just your takings.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a picture you post on Facebook. You only need to review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically sends the customer an SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add the dates, places and times for each week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — it shows greyed out to customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Enter a stock count and it goes down as orders come in, then becomes sold out automatically when it runs out.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone — no separate card terminal needed.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose their collection time slot, and demand is spread evenly across the service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at your truck — payment is taken on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatically answers WhatsApp questions about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much food you can cook at once and how long it takes. As soon as a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the van — and the card terminal you already take payment on.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable internet and the same hours every week. But you work somewhere new every week, at different times, with poor or no mobile signal. HatchGrab was built exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the signal drops, online ordering pauses automatically and customers cannot place orders you would not see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you regularly post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in your dates, places and times and make it ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your Facebook and Instagram posts
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose their collection time. Queues get shorter and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Made for the food truck business, not for restaurants.
